<?php

/**
 * F-457 FIXTURE — a class that merely SHARES THE GUARD'S SHORT NAME must not
 * arm a pin.
 *
 * The old rule matched the bare short name anywhere, so this file's
 * `PeepSoAddPostGuard::pinOnly(` armed a pin that the real guard knows
 * nothing about. This namespace is not the guard's, and nothing here imports
 * the real FQN, so the write below MUST be reported UNPINNED.
 *
 * ⛔ Not loadable and never scanned as part of the tree: .txt under
 * tests/fixtures/, pointed at explicitly.
 */

namespace Fixture\Impostor;

/** Same short name, different namespace, no relation to the real guard. */
final class PeepSoAddPostGuard
{
    /** @param array<int, mixed> $keep */
    public static function pinOnly(array $keep, callable $write): mixed
    {
        unset($keep);

        return $write();
    }
}

/*
 * ⚠⚠ A COMMENT NAMING THE REAL IMPORT. The first version of the
 * fully-qualified rule tested the file TEXT for this line, so this
 * comment alone armed every pin in the file — the comment-names-the-
 * mechanism trap, inside the rule written to close a name-matching hole.
 * The rule reads TOKENS now, so this must still arm nothing.
 *
 * use BCC\Core\PeepSo\PeepSoAddPostGuard;
 */

final class LooksProtectedButIsNot
{
    public function write(int $author): int
    {
        // Spelled exactly like a real pin, and it neutralises nothing.
        return PeepSoAddPostGuard::pinOnly([], static fn () => wp_insert_post([
            'post_type'   => 'peepso-post',
            'post_author' => $author,
        ], true));
    }

    /**
     * ⚠ A METHOD that merely shares a writer's NAME, reached through the
     * nullsafe operator. The skip-list has to know `?->` as well as `->`,
     * or this is reported as a call to the global `wp_insert_post` — a
     * FALSE POSITIVE, and the opposite failure from the one the nullsafe
     * fix in `updateIsNotOnWpdb()` addresses.
     */
    public function aMethodNamedLikeAWriter(): void
    {
        $this->helper?->wp_insert_post(['post_type' => 'x']);
        $this->helper->wp_update_post(['ID' => 1]);
    }
}
